grammar_tips.title: Using 'There is/There are…'
grammar_tips.explanation: Say 'There is…' for one thing and 'There are…' for many things. Example: There are many parks in the city.

explanation_translation.Hindi: एक चीज़ के लिए 'There is…' और कई चीज़ों के लिए 'There are…' कहें। उदाहरण: There are many parks in the city.
explanation_translation.Japanese: 1つのものには「There is…」、複数のものには「There are…」を使います。例: There are many parks in the city.

grammar_tips.title: Using adjectives to describe places
grammar_tips.explanation: Use words like 'crowded', 'peaceful', 'polluted' before nouns. Example: It is a crowded street.

explanation_translation.Hindi: स्थान का वर्णन करने के लिए 'crowded', 'peaceful', 'polluted' जैसे शब्दों का प्रयोग करें। उदाहरण: It is a crowded street.
explanation_translation.Japanese: 場所を説明するとき「crowded」「peaceful」「polluted」などを名詞の前に置きます。例: It is a crowded street.

grammar_tips.title: Using 'in the city/in the countryside'
grammar_tips.explanation: Say 'in the city' or 'in the countryside' to show location. Example: My grandparents live in the countryside.

explanation_translation.Hindi: 'in the city' या 'in the countryside' कहकर स्थान दिखाएं। उदाहरण: My grandparents live in the countryside.
explanation_translation.Japanese: 場所を示すとき「in the city」「in the countryside」を使います。例: My grandparents live in the countryside.

grammar_tips.title: Comparing city and countryside
grammar_tips.explanation: Use '…is busier than…' or '…is more peaceful than…'. Example: The city is busier than the countryside.

explanation_translation.Hindi: तुलना करने के लिए '…is busier than…' या '…is more peaceful than…' का प्रयोग करें। उदाहरण: The city is busier than the countryside.
explanation_translation.Japanese: 比較するとき「…is busier than…」「…is more peaceful than…」を使います。例: The city is busier than the countryside.

grammar_tips.title: Using 'I like… because…'
grammar_tips.explanation: Say 'I like… because…' to explain your opinion. Example: I like the countryside because it is peaceful.

explanation_translation.Hindi: अपनी राय बताने के लिए 'I like… because…' का प्रयोग करें। उदाहरण: I like the countryside because it is peaceful.
explanation_translation.Japanese: 自分の意見を言うとき「I like… because…」を使います。例: I like the countryside because it is peaceful.
